message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: In Zhejiang Ningbo, July 2014, defendant Xu Moujia (徐某甲) without construction qualification contracted a pipeline exhaution building modification for Ningbo Huayi packaging Co. He as contractor didn't pay attention to high-altitude safety measures, violated national safety regulations, knew his workers were violating rules but didn't stop them. Result: worker Wang fell from about 7 meters, died. Investigation found Xu directly responsible. After incident, Xu voluntarily surrendered and confessed. Civil compensation settled.

Thus this is a production safety accident caused by employer's negligence. The charge likely is "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) or "玩忽职守" (dereliction of duty) or "过失致人死亡". In training examples, similar scenario: first example about mine accident: they labeled "重大责任事故". Another example about forklift accident also "重大责任事故". So likely "重大责任事故". Also could be "过失致人死亡". But the list includes "过失致人死亡". In many cases, they used "重大责任事故" for industrial accidents where employer is responsible. The fact says "生产安全责任事故". The label "重大责任事故" appears in list. So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>.
